# Dr Kasra Kassai

> Lecturer in Digital Analytics at London South Bank University (LSBU), researching machine learning, edge computing, and sustainable, energy-efficient computing.

Dr Kasra Kassai is a Lecturer in Digital Analytics at London South Bank University (LSBU). He holds a PhD in Computer Science from LSBU (supervised by Professor Tasos Dagiuklas), a BSc (Hons) in Computer Science, and an MSc in Software Engineering from City, University of London. His research focuses on carbon-aware computing, federated learning, edge and cloud orchestration, and energy-efficient systems for 6G — building practical solutions that align computing workloads with sustainability goals.

- [Publications](https://drkassai.com/publications/): Peer-reviewed papers and scholarly work on federated learning, edge computing, energy estimation, and orchestration.
